title: 1:1 prep - Leila Park (Mar 4, 2026)
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Leila Park
Date: Wed Mar 4, 2026
Length: 30m
Location: Zoom / Leila's calendar

Goal for this 1:1:
- Quick sync on current priorities and blockers for the week
- Career/craft touchpoint (IC growth + leadership opportunities)
- Review PR and rollout timeline for KV cache improvements
- Agree on actions and deadlines

Agenda (30m)
1) Quick personal check-in (3-4m)
   - How's bandwidth / stress this week? family/energy check
2) Status updates (8-10m)
   - KV cache perf work (SRV-482) — where are we? testing signals?
   - E2E regression tests flakiness (noticed high CI flakes last 2 runs)
   - Support backlog: on-call runbook updates
3) Deep dive: PR #918 (6-8m)
   - Blockers for merge? perf numbers to validate (p50/p95 token latency, memory)
   - Can we safely roll canary with current metrics?
4) Career / growth (6-8m)
   - Leila asked about leading a small spike to evaluate KV eviction strategies — discuss scope, expected outcomes, mentor pairing
   - Coaching: giving feedback to peers, running async design reviews
5) Actions & next steps (2-3m)

Prep notes / context (for me):
- Leila dropped her estimate on SRV-482 by 25% last week after the refactor; I want to understand risk vs ship velocity. She tends to under-call risks when eager to land.
- CI flakiness: both unit and integration jobs saw flakes around the same test (cache-ttl-test) — might be timing sensitive. Ask for repro steps and quick plan to quarantine.
- PR #918 is large but isolates change to KV cache eviction heuristics + a shim layer. Requesting two perf runs on a consistent infra image before approving.
- Leila indicated interest in mentorship and running a 1-week spike; good candidate for increased leadership exposure. Consider assigning a senior engineer (Tasha) as mentor.

Talking points / questions to ask Leila:
- How confident are you in the current perf numbers for KV cache? Any variance between machines/instance types?
- What would make you comfortable with a canary rollout? (thresholds, runbook steps)
- For the CI flakes, do you have a minimal repro or hypothesis? Quick fixes vs longer-term fix?
- Are you getting enough design review feedback? Anything I can shield you from?
- Career: would you prefer a short leadership opportunity (1-week spike) or a longer owner role (feature area)?

Notes to self (manager reminders):
- Provide time-block for Leila to run perf benchmarks on Friday (2h) and approve access to the dedicated test fleet image if needed.
- Connect Tasha + Leila by EOD to scope the spike and set success criteria.
- Review the CI run artifacts in SRV-482 board before end of week.

Open issues to track (follow-ups):
- SRV-482: need final perf validation artifact (benchmark logs + analysis) — owner: Leila — due: 2026-03-10
- CI flakes: reproduce and add deterministic test or mark as flaky in CI to stabilize mainline — owner: Leila + SRE liaison (Ravi) — due: 2026-03-08
- PR #918: get two perf runs on identical infra image and update PR description with results — owner: Leila — due: 2026-03-05
- Mentorship pairing: intro + spike scope doc — owner: Oliver — due: 2026-03-06

Action items (captured during meeting)
- Leila: run perf benchmarks on dedicated test fleet; upload artifacts to the PR and link in JIRA SRV-482 (due 2026-03-05)
- Leila: create minimal repro for cache TTL flake and post to #sre-shared (due 2026-03-06)
- Oliver: intro email to Tasha + set up 30m kickoff for spike (due 2026-03-06)
- Oliver: review PR #918 logs and leave final comments if no regressions found (due 2026-03-05)

Potential risks / escalation criteria:
- If perf p95 increases >15% on staging after canary, rollback and open incident (notify SRE + product).
- If CI flakes >3 times in a row for same test, escalate to release engineering for test quarantine.

Conversation cues (empathetic prompts):
- "What would make this week easier for you?"
- "Is there anything I should stop/ start doing to unblock you?"
- "Tell me one thing you learned recently about the runtime internals."

Follow-up: capture action items in JIRA SRV-482 and ping Leila on Slack after this 1:1. Update Leila's development plan with the spike as a temporary leadership goal.

Quick bullet summary to paste into Slack post-1:1:
- Ran through KV cache perf + PR #918. Leila will run 2 perf benchmarks and attach artifacts by 3/5.
- Leila to repro CI flake and post findings by 3/6. Oliver to intro Tasha for spike; kickoff by 3/6.

Misc scratchpad (do not share unless asked):
- Might consider making the spike a small cross-team async doc with acceptance criteria: success = consistent 10-12% throughput improvement without >5% p95 latency regression.
- If Leila wants more leadership, propose co-owning cache layer rollout with Tasha and present results at Eng weekly in 2 weeks.

End of doc.
